notes: Run of 2026-11-17. Eight Registry stories queued. 1900 Kirkwood is published (Board approval of SF Market's demolition and new distribution centre). 475 Sansome is declined over the headline; the Transamerica landmark step is declined as a second account of a designation still in progress. Lantana LED is in Richmond. One Workplace and Hacienda are address-less but for sidebar links; the Pebblebrook and data-center stories answered 429 and their headlines name no building, so they were not retried.

publish.note: One event, one entry: the designation in progress is already on /san-francisco/chinatown/montgomery-street/600/ as Hoodline's 2026-11-12 entry (“Transamerica Pyramid Could Become SF Landmark, Benches and All”). This is the next procedural step of the same designation, not the designation itself. Publish the Board's final adoption when it lands, and set historic_status then.

findings.description: The Board of Supervisors approved lease amendments letting SF Market, the Bayview wholesale produce market, demolish an outdated building at 1900 Kirkwood St. and replace it with a 64,000 sq ft distribution centre; groundbreaking targeted for the first half of 2027.

extra.note: A proposal approval: the team goes here, not in building.

raw.text: The San Francisco Board of Supervisors has approved lease amendments that let SF Market … demolish an outdated building and replace it with a 64,000-square-foot distribution center at 1900 Kirkwood St.

resolution.method: No record in sf-eas-addresses for 1900 KIRKWOOD AVE.
resolution.note: The address does not exist today, so there is no page it can go on. EAS has no address near it on this street either. Per "The evidence bar" in research/AGENTS.md this is a street-hub fact: a dated record of a building at a number the city no longer has.

publish.note: Blocked: sf-eas-addresses has no record of 1900 Kirkwood Avenue (the street's registered numbers jump from the 700s with nothing near 1900), so there is no parcel and no page. SF Market's produce market sits on city land; the fact should not be guessed onto a neighbouring address. Worth retrying if EAS addresses the site.
